reviewedBy: Codex root, scoped source reconstruction and actual Chart.js browser review
reason: Presentation-only Uganda PAYE chart and input readability changes. The chart renderer uses readable legend/tick/grid colours, redraws after the existing theme event, and renders light ink synchronously for print before restoring the on-screen theme. Four page-scoped light input unit, hint and inactive employment-status text selectors change only text colour. Replacing the single changed renderChart function, removing the three declared event listeners and removing those exact styles and the employer-panel screen/print styles recovers the entire baseline HTML byte-for-byte. The browser review also found the existing employer heading nearly white on its pale night-mode panel. Scoped screen styles use the existing dark palette, while print styles use opaque white paper and readable body/heading ink. All 31 other named functions, shared engines, formula data, rates, fixtures, source dates, analytics, forms, routes and local PDF/share handlers remain unchanged. Accept only this route's derived artifact fingerprint fields through the existing selected-formula owner; no statutory or source-freshness change is authorized.
